source.title: Introducing a new generation of Airtable - built for the AI era

licence: observed-and-attributed: cited by URL and timestamp, never re-hosted

singleMoment.what: Prompting Omni AI in natural language to instantly generate complete tables, dashboards, and automated web research workflows

facts.subject: UI Interaction
facts.value: Zooms into the table UI and transitions to a map layout within 2 seconds of entering the prompt

facts.subject: Brand introduction
facts.value: Introduces Omni animated dot mark at 0:10 with centered title text

facts.subject: App builder
facts.value: Displays 'Building table...' loading spinner before rendering interface cards and charts at 0:19

facts.subject: Data ingestion
facts.value: Shows CSV file drop into prompt field at 0:30, transitioning to auto-populated records by 0:36

facts.subject: Competitor Analysis table
facts.value: Shows animated 'Searching the web...' badge inside individual table cells during background agent execution

facts.subject: Template montage
facts.value: Cuts through 7 distinct product interface screens in 6 seconds (approx 0.8s per screen)

motionPurpose: Push-in zooms at 0:04 and 0:43 focus viewer attention directly onto AI generation results within table cells.

whatToSteal.technique: Inline status badges ('Searching the web...') placed directly in table cells to communicate background AI processing.

whatNotToSteal.why: Rapidly cycling through 7 dense application dashboards in under 6 seconds, which prevents viewers from absorbing key product details.
